dedupe_keys.name: plateau use case time series flood evacuation simulation on foot and by car in kumamoto uc22 039

description: This PLATEAU use case, run by Ritec for Japan's transport ministry from April 2022 to March 2023, built a 3D flood evacuation simulation for twelve school districts in Kumamoto City's Minami Ward and the coastal area to its north. A 2021 survey found that in the 2016 Kumamoto earthquake many residents who evacuated by car took a long time or gave up because of congestion, while the city's plan asks for evacuation on foot in a tsunami. The system moves each walker and car along the road network at fixed time steps for all of about 15,000 households over about 63 square kilometres, with walking speeds by evacuee type and car speeds reduced by congestion, and shows the results with time-varying inundation surfaces for flood, storm surge and tsunami on the PLATEAU 3D city model. City staff can compare scenarios for congestion, evacuation time and evacuees per shelter, and residents can replay their own route to build a personal evacuation timeline. Coverage: part of Kumamoto City. Access: public project page with the method and results. Licence: MLIT site policy. Caveats: results were precomputed scenarios; the software itself is not published on the page. Simulation uses are agent-based pedestrian and car evacuation with inundation for district disaster plans. Related records: PLATEAU 3D city models and the Japan hazard population exposure mesh data.
